items.detail: Monotone Gaussian increments require explicit localization/Euler association and strict initial-state covariance; supplied in PROOF_COMPLETIONS.md.
Likelihood powers and quartic moments pay true martingales. Published bounded-derivative uniqueness assumptions do not apply to the cubic drift; no arbitrary SPDE uniqueness inferred.
Use unnormalized mu(x) times initial-parity indicator, or normalized conditional row times its branch probability; never both normalizations.
COARSE mirrored-cell residual about .01535246; fine grids near roundoff. Null continuum thresholds carry grid atoms. No symmetrization, threshold change or false error enclosure.
Bounded decision risk needs an integrated L1/exceptional-event comparison, not pointwise control of every history. Joint likelihood/UI still requires the conditional-cylinder bridge.
Four declared OBS proof hashes/sizes match local originals. Missing uploaded-plan/snapshot/wrapper bytes and historical access are not invented; real local review/plan are bound now.
